Host has no native score-list storage or gameplay consumer; its documented native consumer is a debug overlay, which this single-player task excludes.
Host has no native AiGroupScoreList entries; chosen-flag writes would update only a fabricated auxiliary debug list.
The required live member+304h ResourceUsage values are not exposed by the units interface; existing planner uses a constant substitute.
Existing enabled kDefendThinkImageBound arm already calls this reconstruction with the real kind and objective-set values; adding another call would duplicate it.
Host rack_ammo_per_rack combines carried rounds; native body needs distinct attached child count and reserve+484h, which are not maintained separately.
Reconstruction selects a bot-slot offset; host still lacks the installed native bot-slot pointer and its vtable[1Ch] target-acceptance contract.
